newsitem.title: UK: S&P plans ratings for City Mortgage Receivables.
newsitem.headline: S&P plans ratings for City Mortgage Receivables.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it expected to assign an AA rating to City Mortgage Receivables 7 Plc's 69.5 million pound issue of Class A mortgage-backed floating-rate notes due 2027.
It expected to assign a BBB rating to the 6.9 million pound issue of Class B notes, S&P said in a statement.

"The provisional ratings reflect credit enhancement and liquidity cover (for the Class A and B notes), the ability of the master servicer, sub servicer and standby servicer to perform their roles in this transaction, the sound legal structure of the transaction and the sound payment structure and cash flow mechanics of the transaction," S&P said.

The issue is lead managed by Greenwich Capital Markets Inc and the collateral is a pool of first and second ranking mortgages secured over freehold, leasehold or mixed use property located in England and Wales, or standard securities over residential or mixed use heritable property in Scotland, S&P said.
The closing date is July 31, 1997, it added.
